title: Pixel Index custom character manifest
description: Shape of the manifest.json inside a custom-character upload zip for POST /api/v1/assets (#105). Mirrors services/api/src/assets/decodeCharacter.ts's manifest validation field-for-field, including its permissiveness: unknown properties are not rejected. Identical shape to custom-asset-pet-manifest.schema.json by design — a character and a pet are told apart by their PNG's dimensions/layout, not by manifest shape. See docs/custom-asset-zip-contract.md for the zip-level rules (manifest.json alongside a single 112x96 PNG) this schema doesn't cover.

id.description: Uppercase letters, digits, underscore, starting with a letter. This is the requested asset id — pixel-index suffixes it (_2, _3, ...) on collision.
